external_entities.name: customer company
external_entities.description: A customer organization using the invoicing service as a tenant.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant
external_entities.notes: The description refers to customer companies collectively; they share the billing app, database and PDF bucket.

external_entities.name: customer user
external_entities.description: A person at a customer company who uses the billing app as an admin or viewer.
external_entities.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
external_entities.notes: Users are described as either admins or viewers and authenticate with an email address, password and session cookie.

external_entities.name: payer
external_entities.description: The person who receives an invoice link and views the payment page.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.
external_entities.notes: The text does not state whether the payer is a customer user.

external_entities.name: support agent
external_entities.description: A support employee who uses the admin console and can open billing-app sessions as customer users.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.
external_entities.notes: Each agent has an account and uses a one-time code.

processes.name: billing app
processes.description: The shared web application that authenticates users, serves invoices and payment pages, filters database queries, saves invoice fields, queues PDF jobs and fetches PDFs.
processes.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app
processes.notes: The app adds the company filter to each query itself. The description does not state whether it checks invoice ownership or rechecks roles on requests.

processes.name: admin console
processes.description: A console reachable only from the support office network that lets support agents open billing-app sessions as customer users.
processes.source_excerpt: The admin console is reachable only from there
processes.notes: The text does not state where the console runs.

processes.name: PDF renderer
processes.description: A worker that takes render jobs, reads invoices and writes PDFs to the PDF bucket.
processes.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time
processes.notes: It trusts the company ID carried by a job.

data_stores.name: tenant database
data_stores.description: A shared PostgreSQL database containing every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The billing app keeps every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details in one PostgreSQL database, the tenant database.
data_stores.notes: Every table has a company ID column; the database has no row-level security and the app uses one database account for all companies.

data_stores.name: render queue
data_stores.description: A queue carrying PDF render jobs with a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: To make a PDF, the billing app puts a render job on the render queue.
data_stores.notes: The text does not state how the queue is reached or protected at rest.

data_stores.name: PDF bucket
data_stores.description: A shared bucket storing rendered PDFs under a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: one PDF bucket in our cloud platform
data_stores.notes: The billing app fetches PDFs with one service credential for all companies.

data_flows.name: use billing app
data_flows.description: A customer user uses the billing app in a browser.
data_flows.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
data_flows.authentication: email address, password and session cookie

data_flows.name: open invoice
data_flows.description: A customer user opens an invoice by invoice number.
data_flows.source_excerpt: When a user opens an invoice, the billing app loads it by its invoice number.
data_flows.notes: The text does not state whether the app checks that the invoice belongs to the user's company.

data_flows.name: edit invoice
data_flows.description: A customer user submits the whole invoice to the billing app for saving.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The invoice edit form posts the whole invoice back
data_flows.notes: The posted fields include the paid flag and the company's payout bank account.
data_flows.data_description: whole invoice, including paid flag and payout bank account

data_flows.name: request PDF
data_flows.description: A customer user asks the billing app for a PDF of an invoice.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Any user can ask for a PDF of any invoice, as often as they like.

data_flows.name: view payment page
data_flows.description: A payer follows an invoice link and views the payment page.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The payment page shows the invoice, the company's name and its bank details
data_flows.notes: The payer is not asked to sign in.
data_flows.data_description: invoice, company name and bank details

data_flows.name: query invoices
data_flows.description: The billing app reads and saves tenant records in the database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app adds the company filter to each query itself
data_flows.notes: The app connects with one database account for all companies.
data_flows.authentication: one database account for all companies
data_flows.data_description: invoices, customers and payout bank details

data_flows.name: enqueue render job
data_flows.description: The billing app places a render job on the render queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the billing app puts a render job on the render queue

data_flows.name: take render job
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer takes render jobs from the queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time

data_flows.name: read invoice
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer reads an invoice from the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: reads the invoice from the tenant database
data_flows.data_description: invoice selected using company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: write PDF
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer writes a PDF to the PDF bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number
data_flows.notes: The renderer trusts the company ID the job carries.

data_flows.name: fetch PDF
data_flows.description: The billing app fetches PDFs from the PDF bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app fetches PDFs from the bucket with one service credential for all companies.
data_flows.authentication: one service credential for all companies

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: A support agent signs in to the admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: each agent signs in to it with their own account and a one-time code

data_flows.name: open session
data_flows.description: A support agent opens a billing-app session as a customer user through the admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
data_flows.notes: Everything the agent then does is recorded against the customer user and not against the agent.
data_flows.data_description: customer-user session and subsequent customer-user actions

trust_boundaries.name: cloud platform
trust_boundaries.description: The cloud-platform zone containing the shared billing app, tenant database and PDF bucket.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: one billing app, one database and one PDF bucket in our cloud platform

trust_boundaries.name: support office network
trust_boundaries.description: The network from which support agents work and where the admin console is reachable.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.

trust_boundaries.name: customer company
trust_boundaries.description: A customer-company tenant boundary containing the customer users.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Each user belongs to one company
trust_boundaries.notes: Each customer company is a separate tenant, while the listed application and storage components are shared.

assumptions.assumption: The billing app is internet-facing because invoice links are sent to payers and users access it through a browser.
assumptions.basis: The description says each invoice email sends the payer a link to the payment page and that people use the billing app in a browser.

assumptions.assumption: The tenant database contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: It contains invoices, customer records and payout bank details, which include financial and personal data.

assumptions.assumption: The PDF bucket contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: It stores rendered PDFs of invoices, which contain invoice and bank-detail information.
